summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend testing for KMZ Data Mapping feature and Dokumen & Arsip sidebar restructure. All 8 backend pytest tests passed. All UI scenarios (sidebar nesting, folder expand/collapse, SLA removal, legacy SLA redirects, KMZ CRUD with multi-file, edit-time file add/delete, detail dialog upload+download, search/region filter, page-size selector, mapping delete, viewer role permissions, regression on BA/Kontrak/Teknis pages) worked as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1092 lines — approaching but under 700-line guideline for splitting; consider modularising CRUD builders and per-domain routers in a future refactor.

KMZ file base64 payload is stored inline in MongoDB (files[] array). With 25MB per file and many revisions per mapping, documents can exceed MongoDB's 16MB doc limit. Consider GridFS or a blob store for production.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed KMZ mappings during test; cleaned up at end via DELETE /api/kmz-mappings/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. Sidebar KMZ testid: sidebar-link-doc-kmz. KMZ page uses kmz-mapping-* testids as documented in review. Backend has POST /api/kmz-mappings, POST /api/kmz-mappings/{id}/files, DELETE /api/kmz-mappings/{id}/files/{fid}, DELETE /api/kmz-mappings/{id}. GET supports q,page,page_size. Note: login redirects to '/' then to '/dashboard'; use wait_for_timeout instead of wait_for_url('**/dashboard**').
